# plugin-traces commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `delete` | Delete plugin trace logs |
| `get` | Get detailed information about a plugin trace |
| `list` | List plugin trace logs with optional filtering |
| `related` | Get plugin traces related by correlation ID or record |
| `settings` | View or set plugin trace logging settings |
| `timeline` | Display plugin execution timeline as a hierarchy tree |
